import roman.core as rc
# Acceptance tests
assert rc.to_roman(1) == 'I'
assert rc.to_roman(4) == 'IV'
assert rc.to_roman(9) == 'IX'
assert rc.to_roman(40) == 'XL'
assert rc.to_roman(90) == 'XC'
assert rc.to_roman(400) == 'CD'
assert rc.to_roman(900) == 'CM'
assert rc.to_roman(2024) == 'MMXXIV'
assert rc.to_roman(3999) == 'MMMCMXCIX'
assert rc.to_roman(1994) == 'MCMXCIV'
assert isinstance(rc.to_roman(2024), str)
# ValueError tests
for n in [0, -1, 4000]:
    try:
        rc.to_roman(n)
        assert False, f'Expected ValueError for {n}'
    except ValueError:
        pass
# TypeError tests
for n in ['5', 5.0, None, [1]]:
    try:
        rc.to_roman(n)
        assert False, f'Expected TypeError for {n}'
    except TypeError:
        pass
print('All acceptance tests passed')
